enable_profiling.description: Whether to automatically install color profiles when new devices are connected.

user_profile_dir.description: Directory where user-specific color profiles are stored.

system_profile_dir.description: Directory containing system-wide, read-only color profiles.

device_db.description: Path to the XML database used for matching devices to color profiles.

enable_hardware_calibration.description: Whether to enable support for hardware-based display calibration (e.g., via X-Rite devices).

enable_vendor_profiles.description: Whether to allow vendor-provided ICC profiles to be installed from external sources.

max_profiles_per_device.description: Maximum number of color profiles retained per device. Set to 0 for unlimited.

ignore_devices.description: List of device types to skip during automatic color profiling (e.g., 'scanner', 'printer'). Valid types: monitor, projector, scanner, printer, camera, webcam, display, tablet.

ignore_device_ids.description: List of device vendor:product IDs to ignore (e.g., "046d:c077"). Useful to exclude specific models known to cause issues.

items.description: Vendor and product ID in hex (e.g., 15d9:0a0d).

enable_debug.description: Whether to log debugging messages to syslog (for troubleshooting).

enable_verbose.description: Whether to log verbose informational messages to syslog.

cache_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of colord’s internal cache. Set to 0 for unlimited.
